[[Miniature Greased Lightning]] is a [[miniature]] version of [[Zippy]] that was originally awarded for the fastest [[Rollerbeetle Racing|Roller Beetle Racers]] during [[Canthan New Year]].

==Acquisition==
;[[The Battle Isles]]
*[[Embark Beach]]
**[[Quest]] reward for completing [[Miniature Companion: The Domain of Anguish]] {{gray|(untradeable version)}}
;Historical
* Awarded to players with the 100 best times for [[Rollerbeetle Racing]] from [[Canthan New Year]] 2007 to 2012 

==Notes==
* Each [[account]] was only eligible for a single reward; those with multiple times in the top 100 did not receive multiple miniatures.
* At most, there are 591 tradeable Greased Lightning miniatures in the game.
** [[Canthan New Year 2007]]: 74 unique winners
** [[Canthan New Year 2008]]: 54 unique winners
** [[Canthan New Year 2011]]: 163 unique winners
** Other Canthan New Years (up to 2012): 100 winners. 
** However, there might be fewer than 591 in circulation if any belong to abandoned or [[ban]]ned accounts.
*The [[Feedback:Game updates/20250415|20th Anniversary Celebration update]] added an untradeable version of this miniature to the game.

== Trivia ==
* This miniature shares its model shape with a [[Miniature Black Beast of Aaaaarrrrrrggghhh]] and [[Miniature World-Famous Racing Beetle]].
* The original tradeable version of this miniature was introduced during [[Canthan New Year 2007]]; the award system was changed in [[Canthan New Year 2009|2009]] to allow 100 winners by ensuring that each account could only appear once on the competition ladder.
* This miniature was upgraded to green rarity from gold in the [[Game updates/20090423|April 23, 2009 update]].
* Greased Lightning is the name of the protagonist's [[w:Hot rod|hot rod]] in the musical [[w:Grease (musical)|Grease]].
* This mini was unattainable between the conclusion of [[Canthan New Year 2012]] and the [[Anniversary Celebration|20th Anniversary Celebration]] in 2025.
